prerequisites.summary: External Operator Orchestration Plane Child Configuration Issuance
prerequisites.details: The operator orchestration service must independently generate, sign/admit, and provide a valid OperatorStartupConfig JSON with role='READ_ONLY', unique configId, and matching executable SHA256 before child launch.

prerequisites.summary: Verification of RimWorld Executable CLI Argument Acceptance
prerequisites.details: Empirical proof in target game binary that Verse.GenCommandLine / Unity Player processes -savedatafolder and -operator* tokens correctly upon startup without stripping them or crashing. Checked-in Multiplayer HostUtil.cs is reference usage only.

prerequisites.summary: Physical Existence of Distinct ValidatorUserDataDirectory and ValidatorCwd
prerequisites.details: The directories specified for ValidatorUserDataDirectory and ValidatorCwd must exist, be distinct from WorkerUserDataDirectory, and have proper write permissions for the child process.

prerequisites.summary: Child Read-Only Access to Parent Staged Artifacts
prerequisites.details: The child validator requires read-only access to the staged .rws save game file without lock conflicts or cross-contamination of parent simulation saves.

prerequisites.summary: Distinct Loopback Port and Nonce-Authenticated Stream Binding
prerequisites.details: The child process requires an independent loopback TCP bridge port (-bridgeport) distinct from the parent worker port, bound to the operator-issued capability nonce.

prerequisites.summary: Availability of Full RimWorld Game Assemblies and Core Content
prerequisites.details: Current scratch environment contains only WorkerBridgeMod source and compiled PoC DLLs. Execution of RimWorldWin64.exe requires the full RimWorld game installation (RimWorldWin64_Data, Managed assemblies, Core defs).
